newsitem.title: UK: Guatemala again says it won't join ACPC.
newsitem.headline: Guatemala again says it won't join ACPC.

text.p: Guatemala on Wednesday ruled out joining the Association of Coffee Producing Countries, saying that it advocated a free market rather than holding back supplies. "We don't belong to the ACPC because we dont believe in holding back supplies" Julio Arrivillagea, president of the National Coffee Association of Guatemala (ANACAFE), told reporters.
In London for talks of the International Coffee Organization, he was asked whether Guatemala would reconsider its stance on the ACPC.
It is among six key non-ACPC producers. Others are India, Vietnam, Papua New Guinea, Mexico and Thailand . The ACPC accounts for more than 70 percent of world production.

He also said that Guatemala has exported 3.45 million 60 kg bags of coffee through May 12 for the current crop year starting October 1. He said total exports for the current crop year should reach 3.6 million. - - London Newsroom +44 171 542 7729
